tools.name: webshipper_list_orders
tools.description: List orders in the Webshipper account, 30 per page. Filter by status, your own reference, channel, destination country, free text or creation date. Use page to read more. Webshipper API: GET /orders.

tools.name: webshipper_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id, with its status, delivery and sender addresses, and order lines. Webshipper API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: webshipper_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments (parcels booked with a carrier), 30 per page. Filter by order, carrier, status, tracking number, reference, destination country, return flag, free text or creation date. Webshipper API: GET /shipments.

tools.name: webshipper_get_shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment by id: carrier, service, tracking number, status and addresses. Webshipper API: GET /shipments/{id}.

tools.name: webshipper_list_tracking_events
tools.description: List carrier tracking events (scans and status changes), 30 per page. Pass shipment_id to read one shipment's history. Webshipper API: GET /tracking_events.

tools.name: webshipper_list_carriers
tools.description: List the carriers connected to the Webshipper account (ids, names, carrier types). Use the id in shipment filters. Webshipper API: GET /carriers.

tools.name: webshipper_list_order_channels
tools.description: List the order channels (shops or marketplaces that send orders to Webshipper), 30 per page. Use the id in order filters. Webshipper API: GET /order_channels.

tools.name: webshipper_create_order
tools.description: Create a new order in Webshipper with a delivery address and order lines. Use a new ext_ref for every order: Webshipper's response may not return the new order id, so find the order later with webshipper_list_orders and ext_ref. Creating an order can start shipping work in the account. Webshipper AP

tools.name: webshipper_create_rate_quote
tools.description: Ask Webshipper which shipping rates apply to one parcel sent to an address. Returns the quotes it finds. Webshipper API: POST /rate_quotes.
